results: Clean production startup; 32 seeds, three months, three income/seven expense categories and all starter budget statuses.
Live API rejects invalid/missing amounts, categories, dates, income budgets and missing transaction IDs.
A: global Add Transaction rejects invalid inputs; income/expense save through API and update history, dashboard, budgets, reports; browser reload retains changes.
B: edit amount and delete via confirmation immediately recalculate dashboard, report and balance.
C: set several budgets, exceed Food by $5.50, edit without duplicates and remove budget while retaining spending.
D: current, previous, overspent and empty months show matching UI/API totals, savings rates, largest category and clear empty/N/A states.
Combined filters, no-results/reset and all three downloaded XLSX exports contain the displayed rows/month and totals.
Income reuses transaction mutations: category/month/amount edits and deletion recalculate both affected reports.
All seven screens fit 360/390/768/1024/1440px; mobile dialog fits/scrolls, traps focus and closes with Escape; mobile navigation opens/closes.
Backend outage shows errors without mock data and retains form draft; retry recovers; application-server restart restores the seed data.
